selection.diff_summary:
Summary: This change extends InstCombine’s compare-folding logic for shift operations, adding a special-case rewrite when the compared constant is zero. In that case, equality/inequality against a shifted value is converted into unsigned range checks on the original operand (e.g. `icmp eq (shr X, C), 0` becomes `icmp ult X, threshold`, and `icmp ne` becomes `icmp ugt`).
